ta.title: Technical Artist
ta.subtitle: Shaders · Rendering optimisation · Unity tools · Unity & Unreal

ta.summary: Technical Artist and Unity Engineer with 6+ years shipping real-time 3D on PC, VR, WebGL and mobile. I write shaders (HLSL, Shader Graph), build C# tools and pipelines, and own rendering performance. At Highstreet I led technical art for a VR / PC MMO and built imposter and voxel-lighting systems to keep dense scenes in budget. Today I am founder and technical artist at NPsynC, creating real-time digital humans in Unreal Engine.

la.title: Lighting Artist
la.subtitle: Real-time lighting · Unity URP & Unreal · Lighting tech for VR and WebGL
la.keywords: Lighting Artist, real-time lighting, Unity URP, Unreal Engine, baked lighting, light probes, reflections, post-processing, time of day, technical artist, VR, WebGL
la.summary: Technical Artist with 6+ years in real-time Unity and Unreal, focused on lighting. I light scenes from the sun, sky ambient, controlled bounce, reflections and a few support lights, and I build lighting tech that ships on VR and WebGL: a voxel light baker for streamed VR scenes at Highstreet, and the lighting and rendering of NPsynC's digital humans in Unreal Engine. Latest study: one Unity URP cabin lit for dawn, noon, dusk and night.
skills: Scene and time-of-day lighting, directional sun / moon and sky ambient, real-time and baked lighting, light probes, reflections, bounce control, support spot and area lights, post-processing
3D-texture (voxel) light baking, shader-based relighting (normal / albedo), fog and sky matching, Shader Graph and HLSL lighting shaders
Lighting within VR, WebGL and mobile budgets, CPU/GPU profiling, draw-call and overdraw reduction
Unity (URP), Unreal Engine (character lighting and rendering, MetaHuman), Three.js / WebGL
C#, HLSL, Shader Graph, Blender, Git

bullets: Co-founded and run NPsynC, which provides AI digital-human staff (front-of-house, assistants, concierges) to government and semi-government agencies and companies.
Create the company's digital humans in Unreal Engine (MetaHuman): modelling and texturing, rigging outfits, beard and eyebrow grooms, lighting and rendering.
Characters talk in real time with live lipsync; NPsynC's own neural lipsync runs locally on the GPU and streams facial animation into Unreal Engine at 60 fps.
Led technical art and network programming for Highstreet's VR / PC MMO in Unity, and owned its performance and rendering budgets.

Built a voxel light baker that bakes scene lighting into small 3D textures (one texture read per pixel, whatever the light count); a 45×34×45 volume is 268.9 KB, so each streamed VR scene block carries its own lighting. Used in the Arena and Lobby levels.

When dense forest scenes dropped from 60–72 fps to 35–40 fps (sometimes ~15), built a circular-view imposter system: capture tool, texture atlas and a view-blending shader with normal / albedo relighting.
Wrote custom shaders and tools for the environment art workflow, bridging the asset pipeline and the engine.
Built VR grass: an editor painter, one combined mesh, proximity-activated zones and alpha clip with 4x MSAA, lit by the voxel light baker.
Built a Shader Graph crystal shader: inset-edge meshes, parallax inner layers, sparkles, fake reflections and a growth dissolve.
Built network solutions and UI/UX systems for multi-user experiences, and coordinated the work.
Wrote custom HLSL shaders for specific art directions while holding 60 fps targets.
Owned QC, troubleshooting and optimisation of real-time rendering.
Technical art direction for mobile and web projects.
Earlier contract (Aug 2020 – Mar 2021): React Native front-end development.
Tutored students in C++ memory management, pointers and data structures; post-lecture assistant.
Built features in C# / Unity for HoloFair, an MMO-style virtual event platform in Unity WebGL and one of the first metaverse / virtual-event projects in the MENA region.
Optimised assets and rendering so large shared event spaces ran smoothly in the browser.

earlier: Also: TrueBays Software, full-stack React Native developer (freelance, Jan 2021 – Oct 2021); SAE Institute, game developer and designer (paid internship, Jun 2018 – Jun 2019).
